messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Repair updates are frequently missing, forcing the team to manually chase garages and slowing claim resolution.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-14T16:28:00Z",
   "quote": "We’re drowning in repair updates missing again this week — it’s eating into our daily tasks. We’re stuck calling garages every day because repair updates missing — it’s a constant drag on our team’s productivity and delays claim resolution.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-14T10:43:00+00:00",
   "quote": "First, we’re spending too much time calling garages because we can’t see live repair updates — it’s a daily grind.",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-02T13:41:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’re still having to call garages ourselves every day because the repair updates missing from the system — it’s becoming a real time-sink for our handlers.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-26T11:03:00Z",
   "quote": "We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-30T09:19:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’re constantly phoning suppliers because there’s no live repair status, which is a daily blocker for us.",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-23T08:15:00+00:00",
   "quote": "It’s a real drag — every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow ... because repair updates missing means no visibility.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-19T10:48:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Also, we’re still stuck calling garages manually because the system doesn’t show live repair updates — it’s a daily headache... The repair updates missing is a daily blocker — we have to call every garage to get status, which interrupts our handling workflow and delays settlements.",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-26T09:40:00Z",
   "quote": "Also, repair updates missing — we’re on the phone daily with garages because there’s no live status.",
   "route": "sales"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Repair updates are frequently missing, forcing the team to manually chase garages"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement and all eight quotes, which consistently describe missing live repair updates in the product forcing handlers to manually call garages. This is a product visibility gap across multiple routes (sales, account_management, support) and dates, with no evidence that pricing, contracts, customer IT, or a help article explains it, and the manual chasing described is a workaround. A squad could plausibly act on adding live repair status visibility.", "verdict": "pass"}
